cd /workspace && timeout 165 python3 - <<'PYEOF'
import sys, json, random, itertools, time, subprocess
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
from compiler import build_plan, verify_plan, find_cut
worst=0; found=0
for seed in range(9000, 9600):
    rng=random.Random(seed)
    n=rng.randint(6,12)
    nl=rng.randint(n, 2*n)
    allp=list(itertools.combinations(range(n),2)); rng.shuffle(allp)
    tree=[(i,i+1) for i in range(n-1)]
    rest=[p for p in allp if p not in set(tree)]
    pairs=tree+rest[:max(0,nl-len(tree))]
    links=[[u,v,rng.choice([1,2,3,4,6])] for (u,v) in pairs]
    k=rng.randint(3,6)
    parts=sorted(rng.sample(range(n),k))
    per=rng.choice([1,2,5,10])
    env=[[l, rng.randint(1, links[l][2])] for l in range(len(links)) if links[l][2]>0]
    totcap=sum(per*rr for _,rr in env)
    target=max(1, totcap//(2*len(parts)))
    dem=[[v, target//len(parts) if rng.random()<0.8 else 0] for v in parts]
    if sum(d for _,d in dem)==0: dem[0][1]=1
    linkuv=[(u,v) for u,v,c in links]; base=[c for u,v,c in links]
    cap=[per*dict(env).get(l,0) for l in range(len(links))]
    demand={v:d for v,d in dem}
    t0=time.time(); plan=build_plan(n,linkuv,cap,parts,demand,randomized=False,det_budget=2.0); t1=time.time()
    if plan is not None: continue
    t2=time.time(); cut=find_cut(n,linkuv,cap,parts,demand,deadline=time.time()+4.0); t3=time.time()
    if cut is not None: continue
    found+=1
    # service-level timing
    cmds=[{"op":"load","n":n,"links":links,"bookings":[]},
          {"op":"prepare","id":"pa","owner":"o","window":[0,per*3],"period":per,"participants":dem,"envelope":env,"rev":0}]
    t4=time.time()
    out=subprocess.run([sys.executable,"-I","-B","submission/main.py"],input="\n".join(json.dumps(c) for c in cmds)+"\n",capture_output=True,text=True)
    t5=time.time()
    r=json.loads(out.stdout.splitlines()[-1])
    ok = r.get('status')=='prepared'
    if ok:
        problems=[]
        sys.path.insert(0,'/tmp')
        from validate import validate
        validate(cmds, out.stdout.splitlines().__class__([json.loads(x) for x in out.stdout.splitlines()]), problems)
        if problems: print("PROB",seed,problems[:2])
    if t5-t4 > worst: worst=t5-t4; wseed=seed; wr=r.get('status')
    print(f"seed {seed}: n={n} k={k} service={r.get('status')}/{r.get('kind','')} {t5-t4:.1f}s")
print("hard instances:",found,"worst service time %.1fs seed %d status %s"%(worst,wseed,wr))
PYEOF
